metric: the corrected metric of 2026-10-16 (version 2; SPEC section 1): g = diag(e^{-2a4} b4 cot^2 z, e^{2a4} (x3), -1, -e^{-2a4} b4 (sin^2 z)^{1/6} (x3)), z = 6 H x0 real
spec: Revision/SPEC.md sections 1, 5 and 7: the Kohn-Sham energy-momentum tensor as a source of the a4 and b4 equations, on the history a4 = H x4, b4 = e^((4/3) H x4)
conditions: C1: every component of the source independent of x0 (for every a4 and b4)
C2: p0 = p_t (the hidden and the extra-time components of the left-hand sides are equal)

C4 (the history a4 = H x4, b4 = e^((4/3) H x4), the author's weights, Lambda = -10): the source kappa T - Lambda of exponentialHistory.authorWeights.historySource_kappaT_minus_Lam (a function of kk = e^{(2/3) H x4}, p0 = p_t)
conclusion: No Kohn-Sham state recorded in Revision/kohn_sham is an admissible source of the corrected metric: C1 fails for every nonzero state, for every a4(x4) and b4(x4); C2 (p0 = p_t) holds exactly for the lambda = 0 states and fails for lambda != 0; C3 holds; the states are not the source C4 that the history needs (no constant kappa reproduces its ratios).  The Kohn-Sham history a4 = H x4, b4 = e^((4/3) H x4) is a prescribed background without back-reaction.

checks.name: ks_profiles_depend_on_x0
checks.detail: 75 ground-state profiles of Revision/kohn_sham/results/ground/profiles (70 with a nonzero energy-momentum tensor): for every nonzero one the energy density rho(y) varies along the hidden coordinate y (a function of x0 alone), (max rho - min rho)/max|T| >= 0.456213 (smallest: N592_lamm2_a20); the left-hand sides of the a4 and b4 equations (a4-equations.json generalSource: x4, x1..x3 and x0 = x5..x7 components) contain no x0, cot z or tan z: True (generalSource.x0_dependence: 'the left-hand sides are free of x0 (and of a4, b4 except thr'), so every component of an admissible source is independent of x0 (C1) and none of these states is an admissible source, for any history

checks.name: ks_hidden_pressure_condition
checks.detail: C2: the hidden and the extra-time components of every left-hand side are equal (a4-equations.json generalSource.hiddenEqualsExtraTimes: 'cally, so kappa (p0 - p_t) = 0: p0 = p_t'), so a source needs p0 = p_t; a Kohn-Sham state has p0 - p_t = sum w g f [(eps - v_v) n_o - M_eff s_o - kappa |k| t_o], the kinetic pressure along the hidden direction (ks-theory.json emt.fieldEquationCondition). It holds to rounding (max_y |p0 - p_t|/max|T| <= 1e-12; largest 4.7533e-17) for exactly the 10 nonzero states with lambda = 0: their occupied orbitals are the fold-band orbitals (e^{f M y}, 0) with eps = kappa k (and the k = 0 zero modes), whose hidden kinetic pressure vanishes identically, and e_int = 0; it fails (> 1e-06) for every one of the 60 states with lambda != 0 (smallest: 0.080929 at N2352_lamm1_a00): the interaction bends the orbitals; states in between: none

checks.name: ks_offdiagonal_condition
checks.detail: C3: the left-hand sides have no off-diagonal component (a4-equations.json generalSource.offDiagonal: '0 = kappa T^mu_nu for every mu != nu (the left-hand sides va...'), so a source needs T^x4_x0 = 0; the Kohn-Sham eigen-orbitals have it (ks-theory.json emt.offDiagonal: 'T^x4_y = 0 for eigen-orbitals (K_x4y = f P (eps - v/2) c_o, c_o = 0)'): C3 holds for every recorded state; it is C1 (and C2 for lambda != 0) that excludes them

checks.name: ks_history_is_a_prescribed_background
checks.detail: the Kohn-Sham history (ks-theory.json adiabaticity.history: a4 = H x4, b4 = e^((4/3) H x4), historyBeta = 4/3; a4-equations.json exponentialHistory.authorWeights.recordHistory: 'AA = 1, be = 4/3, a0 = 0, b4(0) = 1: kk = e^{(2/3) H x4}') needs, with the author's weights and Lambda = -10, the x0-independent source kappa T - Lambda of authorWeights.historySource_kappaT_minus_Lam, a function of kk = e^{(2/3) H x4} with p0 = p_t: True; kappa rho > 0 at every slice: False; a4,0 = 0 (kk = 1): kappa rho = 3.57407, p3/rho = -1.26713, p0/rho = p_t/rho = -2.38212; a4,0 = 0.5 (kk = 1.39561): kappa rho = 1.45327, p3/rho = -1.46539, p0/rho = p_t/rho = -4.51432; a4,0 = 1 (kk = 1.94773): kappa rho = -1.2122, p3/rho = -0.762574, p0/rho = p_t/rho = 3.16321; a4,0 = 1.5 (kk = 2.71828): kappa rho = -4.35889, p3/rho = -1.05837, p0/rho = p_t/rho = 0.00685321; a4,0 = 2 (kk = 3.79367): kappa rho = -7.63383, p3/rho = -1.13246, p0/rho = p_t/rho = -0.691638. Its ratios do not depend on the unknown kappa. The Kohn-Sham source, averaged over x0 per proper volume (the most an x0-independent source could be), has N592_lam0_a00: rho_bar = 0.034125, p3/rho = 0.333333, p0/rho = 0, p_t/rho = 0; N592_lam0_a10: rho_bar = 0.00237112, p3/rho = 0.333333, p0/rho = -5.01209e-18, p_t/rho = 0; N592_lam0_a20: rho_bar = 0.000164754, p3/rho = 0.333333, p0/rho = 0, p_t/rho = 0; N2352_lam0_a00: rho_bar = 0.216249, p3/rho = 0.333333, p0/rho = 0, p_t/rho = 0; N2352_lam0_a10: rho_bar = 0.0150258, p3/rho = 0.333333, p0/rho = -9.32476e-19, p_t/rho = 0; N2352_lam0_a20: rho_bar = 0.00104404, p3/rho = 0.333333, p0/rho = 1.53043e-18, p_t/rho = 0; at every recorded state with a nonzero energy density the ratios (p3/rho, p0/rho, p_t/rho) differ from the needed ones by at least 1.3733 (closest: N592_lamp2_a15). The history is therefore a PRESCRIBED test-field background without back-reaction, not a solution of the a4 and b4 equations with the Kohn-Sham source; equations of state derived from it are not consequences of the coupled field equations
